chapter: Cincinnati, Buffalo, Russell and Fletcher Henderson
title: Joining Fletcher Henderson after Russell and the band's personnel
summary: He names Sandy Williams, Bobby Stark, Coleman Hawkins, Don Redman, Rex Stewart, Clarence Holiday and others.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Now, we're into the 1930's, with the time that you were playing with Louis Russell, 1928 to 1930 you said you played with him. Who did you play with after that, right after you left Louis Russell's band?
See, that was Louis Russell's band.
I don't know what year it was ... Lionel Hampton and Louis Russell. we was in a theatre.
You were with Fletcher Henderson before you went together.
Who was in that band at the time?
Oh brother! We had Sandy Williams, (Y.) Williams, (Y) Jay C. Higginbotham, (Y.) Bobby Stark, (Y.) Coleman Hawkins - everybody in the band was (Y.)
Yes, Don Redman. And Rex Stewart was with us for a while and Bob Stark and Billie Holiday's father, Clarence Holiday.
Yeah, and John Kirby and Russell Smith.
